# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def decide(observation, memory):
    """Use a safety-gated, hysteretic target tracker with bounded reacquisition memory."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})

    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    scan_direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
    scan_ticks = int(memory.get("scan_ticks", 0))
    last_steer = memory.get("last_steer", "")

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_confidence = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_confidence = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost_steps = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety_confidence = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    closing_risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])
    heading_error = abs(float(observation["heading_error"]))

    if safety_confidence < 0.60 or closing_risk >= 0.75:
        memory.update(state="STOPPED", scan_ticks=0, last_steer="")
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    confirmed = visible and target_confidence >= 0.55 and identity_confidence >= 0.60
    if not confirmed:
        memory["scan_ticks"] = scan_ticks + 1
        if state in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "VERIFY", "REACQUIRE"} or lost_steps > 0:
            memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
            if lost_steps <= 1:
                return "STOP", 0.92, memory
            if scan_ticks % 3 == 0:
                scan_direction = (
                    "SCAN_RIGHT" if scan_direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
                )
        memory["scan_direction"] = scan_direction
        memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
        return scan_direction, 0.74, memory

    memory["scan_ticks"] = 0
    if track_age < 2:
        memory.update(state="VERIFY", last_steer="")
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    if distance == "near":
        if heading_error <= 15.0 and identity_confidence >= 0.80:
            memory.update(state="ARRIVED", last_steer="")
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory
        steer = "VEER_LEFT" if bearing < 0 else "VEER_RIGHT"
        memory.update(state="APPROACH", last_steer=steer)
        return steer, 0.87, memory

    if bearing < -12.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        action = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif bearing > 12.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        action = "VEER_RIGHT"
    elif observation["corridor_center"] and abs(bearing) <= 20.0:
        action = "FORWARD"
    elif observation["corridor_left"] and not observation["corridor_right"]:
        action = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif observation["corridor_right"]:
        action = "VEER_RIGHT"
    elif last_steer:
        action = last_steer
    else:
        action = "STOP"

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH" if action != "STOP" else "STOPPED"
    memory["last_steer"] = action if action.startswith("VEER_") else ""
    confidence = 0.90 if action in {"FORWARD", "VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"} else 0.98
    return action, confidence, memory
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
